heading.en: Why does iodine turn rice water blue?
heading.kn: ಅಯೋಡಿನ್ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ತೊಳೆದ ನೀರನ್ನು ನೀಲಿ ಮಾಡುವುದೇಕೆ?

hook.en: A drop of iodine turns starch blue-black but leaves a cotton thread white, though both are long chains of glucose. The difference lies in their shape.
hook.kn: ಪಿಷ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ಹತ್ತಿಯ ದಾರ ಎರಡೂ ಗ್ಲೂಕೋಸ್‌ನ ಉದ್ದ ಸರಪಳಿಗಳು. ಆದರೆ ಅಯೋಡಿನ್ ಪಿಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ನೀಲಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಅವುಗಳ ಆಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿದೆ.

objectives.en: Describe starch, glycogen, cellulose, inulin and chitin.
Describe the bonds that link monomers in biopolymers.
Identify purines, pyrimidines and the parts of a nucleic acid.

narration.en: A drop of iodine turns starch blue-black but leaves a cotton thread white, though both are long chains of glucose. The difference lies in their shape.
narration.kn: ಪಿಷ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ಹತ್ತಿಯ ದಾರ ಎರಡೂ ಗ್ಲೂಕೋಸ್‌ನ ಉದ್ದ ಸರಪಳಿಗಳು. ಆದರೆ ಅಯೋಡಿನ್ ಪಿಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ನೀಲಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಅವುಗಳ ಆಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿದೆ.

body.en: Polysaccharides are long chains of monosaccharides joined by glycosidic bonds. Cellulose is a homopolymer of glucose and is the main component of plant cell walls; paper and cotton fibre are cellulose. Starch, the plant storage form, forms helical secondary structures that can hold I₂ molecules, giving a blue colour; cellulose has no complex helices and cannot hold iodine. Glycogen is the animal storage form; inulin is a polymer of fructose. In a polysaccharide chain the right end is the reducing end and the left end the non-reducing end. Complex polysaccharides with amino-sugars and chemically modified sugars, such as chitin in the exoskeleton of arthropods, are heteropolymers.

points.en: Inulin: fructose polymer; chitin: complex polysaccharide.

narration.kn: ಪಾಲಿಸ್ಯಾಕರೈಡ್‌ಗಳು ಗ್ಲೈಕೋಸಿಡಿಕ್ ಬಂಧದಿಂದ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದ ಮೊನೊಸ್ಯಾಕರೈಡ್‌ಗಳ ಸರಪಳಿಗಳು. ಪಿಷ್ಟದ ಸುರುಳಿ ಅಯೋಡಿನ್ ಹಿಡಿದು ನೀಲಿ ಬಣ್ಣ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಸೆಲ್ಯುಲೋಸ್‌ಗೆ ಈ ಸುರುಳಿ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಇನ್ಯುಲಿನ್ ಫ್ರಕ್ಟೋಸ್‌ನ ಬಹುಅಣು.

body.en: Nucleic acids (DNA and RNA) are polynucleotides. A nucleotide has a heterocyclic nitrogenous base, a monosaccharide and a phosphate. The bases are purines (adenine, guanine) and pyrimidines (cytosine, uracil, thymine). The sugar is ribose in RNA and 2′-deoxyribose in DNA. In a polynucleotide, phosphate links the 3′-carbon of one sugar to the 5′-carbon of the next by an ester bond on each side: a phosphodiester bond. DNA exists as a double helix (Watson–Crick model) with A pairing with T and G with C.

points.en: Purines: A and G. Pyrimidines: C, U, T.
DNA has thymine; RNA has uracil.

narration.kn: ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಿಕ್ ಆಮ್ಲಗಳು ಪಾಲಿನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯೋಟೈಡ್‌ಗಳು. ಅಡೆನಿನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ವಾನಿನ್ ಪ್ಯೂರಿನ್‌ಗಳು; ಸೈಟೋಸಿನ್, ಯುರಾಸಿಲ್, ಥೈಮಿನ್ ಪಿರಿಮಿಡಿನ್‌ಗಳು. ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯೋಟೈಡ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಫಾಸ್ಫೋಡೈಎಸ್ಟರ್ ಬಂಧ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: The DNA double helix: two polynucleotide strands with a sugar-phosphate backbone, held together by A–T and G–C base pairs.

narration.en: The DNA double helix: two polynucleotide strands with a sugar-phosphate backbone, held together by A–T and G–C base pairs.

problem.en: A double-stranded DNA sample has 20% adenine. Find the percentage of thymine, guanine and cytosine.

steps.en: In double-stranded DNA, A pairs with T, so T = A = 20%.
G pairs with C, so G = C = 30% each.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A double-stranded DNA sample has 20% adenine. Find the percentage of thymine, guanine and cytosine.

body.en: The two purines, the double-ring bases, are adenine and guanine. All the rest (C, U, T) are pyrimidines; the longer name has the smaller (single-ring) molecule.

narration.en: Purines are "pure as gold". The two purines, the double-ring bases, are adenine and guanine. All the rest (C, U, T) are pyrimidines; the longer name has the smaller (single-ring) molecule.

mnemonic.en: "PURe As Gold" = Purines: A, G. "CUT the PYe" = Pyrimidines: C, U, T
